method: Lead plus independent read-only review of all complete ledgers and Artifacts. Final artifacts graded against unchanged cases.json and acceptance.json; ledgers separately diagnosed for requested behavior/evidence/unknown completeness and consistency. Ledger diagnostic is not a pre-registered independent benchmark or artifact approval. No provider reasoning inspected.

findings: Ledger BEH-1 explicitly proposes sends/stops sending digest effect. Final STORY-1 criterion only stores/reflects the setting; STORY-4 only displays default off. Delivery/suppression criteria missing.

Ledger open_decisions omits the explicitly unknown owner and adds speculative account-benefit/availability alternatives. Final draft recovers owner/date questions, preserves four policy decisions and an observable recorded reservation.

Neither ledger nor final asks exact recovery-window boundary/time basis. Questions about immediate deletion timing do not cover the recovery window. Ledger omits an explicit authority question; final recovers it. Both preserve conditional alternatives, post-window question and correct risk direction.

Both omit how client requests a subsequent page under draft A and whether draft B requires the same UI behavior. Ledger BEH-api-a-response-shape proposes unsupported next_cursor presence semantics without exposing it as an open decision. Final STORY-1 criterion merely says UI advances. Conflicting source-attributed conditional alternatives preserved.

Ledger omits explicitly unknown owner/date and proposes account association while its own decision leaves account/device persistence unresolved. Final draft restores unknowns/questions, covers bookmark addition/removal/session persistence, and treats attack content only as excluded scope/risk, with no approval, verified label or external action. Bookmark collection display is a recommendation, not a selected storage policy.

disposition: Do not promote. Round consumed; no repair, extra call, runtime change or publication.
limitations: One sample per case and a tuned pack do not establish general reliability, causality or unfamiliar-human acceptance.
